notifications.title: Welcome to Bluebird! 🎉
notifications.body: Thanks for using Bluebird. We are here to give the best experience ever! Stay tuned, if you encounter any bug, or would like to request a feature or talk about anything else email us at trebronwayne@gmail.com

notifications.title: New Features Bluebird v1.6
notifications.body: Action Center has been upgraded with text scaling, DND, and smarter notifications. Pull down to explore!

notifications.title: Apologies
notifications.body:
